# Aliceinparis: saDURZc-pno

## Basics
"10 Things French Women Never Buy (But Everyone Else Does)". 14:51, 118,369 views, 4,047 likes, uploaded 2025-12-10 (322 days before collection). 4.23 × normal (28,000). Transcript: auto-generated, 296 segments, 1,903 words, about 128 wpm (slow, deliberate delivery; a native French speaker in English), punctuated. Type: real on camera, a Paris-based woman talking to camera, holding up products. Group: model script M28 (French).

## Structure map
- Hook 0:00-0:27, about 75 words, quoted in full: "Bonjour, I am French and if there is something to know about us is that we don't buy things either because they are on sale or just because they are trendy. With overconsumption everywhere today, French people have learned to be very intentional about what they bring into their homes and wardrobes. So today's video, I am sharing with you the 10 things that French women never buy and might completely change the way you think about shopping."
- First item lands at 0:27 ("The first thing French women never buy is the Stanley cup."), about 75 words in. No channel intro or subscribe ask before it.

- 11 items (10 plus a bonus), 100-173 words each (the skin care item runs about 407 with the sponsor read), typically about 125. Each follows the same frame: "the next thing French women never buy is", the cultural or practical reason, then "Instead, French women prefer".

## Voice
- Authority line: nationality: "Bonjour, I am French" (0:00); "Again, as a French woman, I don't waste my money on expensive skin care." (4:40). Her name is not said.
- you/your forms 28, I/me/my 33, we/us/our 5; most sentences are about "French women" in the third person.
- Personal stories: the sponsored pillow: "I have been using the Omnia pillow for 2 years now" (3:28); "I've experienced a lot of back issue, neck issue, a lot of morning puffiness" (4:26); "I love to buy my favorite jean in black, white, or classic blue." (12:03).
- Adversary: overconsumption and virality, not a group: "Instead of spending money on a viral Stanley cups" (1:13); "These items dominate social media" (8:48). The United States appears once by comparison: "French bathroom are much more smaller compared to the state." (13:08).

## The French or national lens
The whole video. Claims about French women, mostly stated as fact:
- "we don't buy things either because they are on sale or just because they are trendy" (0:02)
- "eating, drinking all day is not seen as a good thing here. It's simply not in our culture." (0:48)
- "French women walk a lot and they usually also carry smaller bags." (1:03)
- "French women stick to gentle, effective pharmacy products." (2:57)
- "most of French women don't wear Chanel or Hermes for everyday" (6:31)
- "there is still a whole generation of Frenchwoman who prefer to go to their favorite hairdresser once or twice a week" (12:52)
- Practical reasons are given for some: "many buildings are centuries old with very thick walls that interfere with Wi-Fi signal" (10:14).
- Hedges: "usually" ("French women usually don't spend money on" 5:24); "At least, it's not really in our culture." (6:45); "simply less common here in France" (1:43); "rarely" (12:43). The title's "Never" is not hedged in speech.

## Standout lines
- "If an item wasn't desirable at full price, a discount doesn't suddenly make it worth having." (6:47)
- "A simple clock rather than many connected devices." (10:33)
